test_image_conversion: test the to_numpy_array method to convert PIL images, numpy arrays, and torch tensors with rescale and channel dimension options
test_image_list_conversion: test make_list_of_images, make_flat_list_of_images, and make_nested_list_of_images to convert single images, batches, and nested lists
test_image_resize: test the resize method to resize PIL images, numpy arrays, and torch tensors with size, default_to_square, and max_size parameters
test_image_normalization: test the normalize method to normalize PIL images, numpy arrays, and torch tensors with mean and std parameters
test_image_crop: test the center_crop method to crop PIL images, numpy arrays, and torch tensors to specified sizes
test_image_load: test the load_image function to load images from URLs, local paths, base64 strings, and RGBA/LA/L mode PIL images
test_channel_dimension: test get_image_size, infer_channel_dimension_format, and get_channel_dimension_axis to detect channel dimension in numpy arrays
test_image_to_pil: test the to_pil_image method to convert numpy arrays and torch tensors back to PIL images with channel reordering and rescaling
